name_en: Kintoki mame barazushi — scattered sushi mixed with sweet kidney beans
summary_ja: 醤油と砂糖で甘めに煮た金時豆と、こんにゃくやにんじんなど旬の具材を酢飯に混ぜ込む。米が育ちにくかった徳島で、具をたっぷり加えてかさを増やす工夫から生まれたとされ、祭りや節句に振る舞われる。
summary_en: Kintoki kidney beans simmered sweet in soy sauce and sugar are mixed into vinegared rice along with konjac, carrot, and other seasonal ingredients. Said to have arisen in Tokushima's rice-poor soil as a way to stretch rice with plentiful fillings, served at festivals and seasonal celebrations.
source_title: 金時豆入りばら寿司 徳島県｜うちの郷土料理：農林水産省
